simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אִמַּר (H563) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אִמַּר (ʼimmar) means a lamb First listed occurrence: Ezra 6 9.

definitions.full: H563. immar [ אִמַּר ] noun masculine lamb (Assyrian immeru (also = child ; immertu , girl ; conjectures as to etymology Dl Prol. 28 Jen ZMG xiiii (1889), 203 ; ZA vii. 216 Schw Idioticon 114 ), אמריא ᵑ7 ; Syriac , Punic אמר , Palmyrene plural emphatic אמריא Lzb 220 Cooke Inscr. 120. 337 ; Arabic (loan-word ? compare Frä 107 , but also DHM VOJ i. 24 )); — plural אִמְּרִין , lambs , as sacrificial victims Ezra 6:9 , 17 ; 7:17 . אִנְבֵהּ see אֵב .
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) perhaps from 560 (in the sense of bringing forth);
